headline: Recommended screening at least 3 and up to 5 candidates for Budget/Management Analyst to full City Council
summary: The committee elected a vice chair and clerk, then heard a presentation from Gerald Perry on the Budget/Management Analyst position, including salary history, workload, and legal considerations. The committee voted to recommend at least 3 and up to 5 candidates to the full City Council and discussed confidentiality protocols for applicant materials before entering executive session.
decisions: Decided to recommend at least 3 and up to 5 candidates to the full City Council for review, 3-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Rotondo nominates Spang to serve as Vice Chair; Houseman seconds; the motion carries 3-0.
Houseman nominates Rotondo to serve as Clerk; Spang seconds; the motion carries 3-0.
Rotondo motions to recommend at least 3 and up to 5 candidates to the full Council for review; Spang seconds; the motion carries 3-0.
